tool.title: Record Deliverables
tool.description:
Use this tool whenever you create a finished, user-facing file and want it saved to the Deliverables library. Supported files: Markdown, Word, PowerPoint, PDF, Excel, web pages, and images.

Only record what the user is meant to read, review or share. Do not record source code, configuration, or project files such as .ts, .js, .py, .css, or .json, and skip outputs that only check your own work (validation or dry-run output, debug screenshots, temporary files).

Revisions: recording a filePath that is already in the library updates that entry as a new revision. When a draft goes through several rounds, rewrite the same file and record it again instead of logging every round as a new deliverable.

Title: a short name for what the deliverable is, in the user's language. Never the file name, and no version or draft markers (V2, v3, draft, final …) — revisions are tracked automatically.

action:
  record — add a finished file to the library, or record a new revision of a file already in it (requires filePath and title; add textPreview for Markdown)
  list   — show saved deliverables; optionally filter by sessionId
  remove — delete a deliverable record by id
